items.why: Extending Friday's 6% rally on AI momentum: reports of a new in-house AI chip, expanded compute capacity, and a fresh model launch, plus BofA's reiterated Buy rating with an $835 target.
Riding Friday's 4.7% jump after Q3 deliveries of 486,532 beat Wall Street estimates of roughly 450,000 to 460,000; analysts now look ahead to the Oct 21 earnings report.
IBD's live coverage names Microsoft among today's pops as tech leads the Nasdaq to a fresh record; the stock is riding AI-infrastructure optimism alongside peers.

market_note: Midday Monday: S&P and Nasdaq futures held gains; the 10-year yield climbed toward 5.33% while oil slipped, keeping the Dow near flat.
summary: Nasdaq hit a fresh record led by big tech while the S&P 500 edged higher; the Dow lagged and oil fell as the 10-year yield climbed to new highs.
